title: Define review tracts and acceptance artifacts for contract/tech/design dependencies
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Purpose: Remove ambiguity in PRD acceptance by creating discrete 'review tracts' that map PRD sections to the exact artifact or sign-off required from Eng / Design / Legal. Scope: - Private deployment PRD (VPC + on-prem packaging) changes: network diagram updates, KMS/HSM integration, new rollback/upgrade path. - Cross-team impact areas: contract amendments (legal), deployment UX (design), runtime compatibility & upgrade strategy (eng). Deliverables: 1) Review tract matrix (PRD section -> owner -> required artifact link -> acceptance condition). 2) Sign-off checklist templates per team (legal clause reference + decision rationale; design mock approval with accessibility checklist; eng acceptance with performance regression target and deployment playbook). 3) Clear timeline and gating rules for merge-to-release. Acceptance criteria (high level): - Legal: documented clause changes and risk assessment for data residency + indemnity language; Legal lead signs off via comment and attachment. - Design: high-fidelity screenshots showing new VPC setup flow + annotated accessibility and localization checks; Design lead approves in Figma and links the file. - Engineering: automated integration test, deployment runbook, and SLO impact analysis showing <5% latency regression at 95th percentile in dedicated tests; Eng lead posts CI link and a deployment cadence commit. - All sign-offs must include a mandatory remediation plan if acceptance criteria are not met. Process proposal: 1) Attach tract matrix to PRD (section per row) and tag owners. 2) Owners have 5 business days to respond with either 'approve', 'request changes' (with concrete list), or 'block' (with mandatory mitigation plan). 3) If a block is raised, PMs coordinate a triage meeting within 48 hours to decide path forward (scope reduce / extend schedule / legal negotiation). Communication channels and artifacts: - Slack channel: #prd-priv-deploy-review (observe threads per tract) - Google Drive PRD + tract spreadsheet - Figma links for flows - GitHub PR template updated to require sign-off links. Risks: - Stalled legal negotiations delaying release; mitigation: escrow sign-off option and feature flag gating. - Ambiguous acceptance criteria leading to rework; mitigation: standardize template examples. Next steps (owner assigned): - Draft the tract matrix template (PM) - Circulate to Legal/Design/Eng for one-week feedback (assignee: Ravi) - Pilot on this PRD and iterate post-retro.
